pass=0
fail=0
failures=()

run_case() {
    local name="$1"
    local fixture="$2"
    local expected="$3"

    local actual
    actual="$("$BIN" --parse "$fixture" 2>/dev/null)"
    local rc=$?
    if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
        failures+=("$name: non-zero exit ($rc)")
        fail=$((fail+1))

    if [ "$actual" = "$expected" ]; then
